newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Mozambique's Chissano sacks two from his government.
newsitem.headline: Mozambique's Chissano sacks two from his government.

text.p: Mozambican President Joaquim Chissano on Wednesday dropped a minister and a deputy minister from his government following press criticism of the pair.
The presidency in Maputo said in a short statement that Social Welfare Minister Alcinda Abreu and Deputy Minister for Culture, Youth and Sport Salomao Manhica had been relieved of their posts.
No reasons were given but earlier this year Mozambican newspapers predicted both would be sacked.
No replacement was named for Manhica but Abreu's deputy minister, Filipe Mandlate, has been appointed as her "interim" replacement.
